title: Missing Lid
text: Missing Lid. This coffee container would have been great except the top of it was completely missing and I wasn't able to replace it because of Amazon for some reason. Oxo is usually a good product but it would have been nice to have this to store my coffee in.

description: OXO Steel POP Coffee Container with Scoop-  1.7 Qt for Coffee, Tea and MoreOXO SteeL POP Containers are a smart solution for storing dry foods and keeping ingredients close at hand. Push-button lids create an airtight seal with a single press, so your favorite staples stay fresh. The button pops up for easy, one-handed opening. Each Container is sized to hold household essentials like cereal, flour, sugar, pasta, rice, coffee, nuts, snacks and more. Containers nest with their lids on for convenient storage. POP Containers aren’t just for kitchens: Use them any place you want more organization. For best results, always use the button to open and close. Do not carry POP Containers by the lid.OXO Good Grips 3-PC Small Square Short POP Container SetThe OXO good grips two-piece pop container value set is the key to keeping dry foods fresh and countertops clutter-free. Airtight, stackable, space-efficient, and now completely dishwasher safe, These containers can be customized to fit any space. This three-piece set is perfectly calibrated for kitchen essentials like 1 lb boxes or bags or brown sugar, coffee, tea and snacks. With a handy fill line to guide you, curved corners for smooth dispensing and sturdy, BPA-free construction pop containers take tidying to the next level. Pop containers aren't just for kitchens: use them any place you want more organization. Set includes: three 1.1 Qt containers ideal for 1 lb of brown or confectionery sugar, tea and snacks.
